item.title: Former Sundance Head Tabitha Jackson Will Next Lead NYC’s Film Forum
item.description: Nearly four years since departing Sundance as festival director, Jackson's latest gig sees her running her very own "local movie theater."

item.title: ‘Michael’ Trailer: What Are We Not Going to See in the King of Pop’s Splashy New Biopic?
item.description: Antoine Fuqua's long-awaited Michael Jackson film stars the pop superstar's own nephew in the title role and seems to focus on the early part of his career. That leaves plenty of material on the table.

item.title: Subscribe to Our Craft Newsletter, Top of the Line: This Week, A Last Dance at Sundance
item.description: Week 8 of IndieWire's Craft newsletter celebrates cinematography and Sundance, and the psychopath chic of "The Housemaid."

item.title: Every Documentary Filmmaker Should Be Worried About the Success of ‘Melania’
item.description: The film is the latest streamer-funded, carefully choreographed, boring, celebrity puff piece being branded as a documentary. It's also a harbinger of what sorts of "true stories" are being championed these days.

item.title: The 17 Best Films of the 2026 Sundance Film Festival
item.description: Goodbye, Park City, and hello to an assortment of new narrative features, documentaries, and rising stars to celebrate (and get to know better).

item.title: Is Nancy Meyers Making Another Christmas Movie Next?
item.description: The beloved filmmaker is back, with an untitled, star-studded film due out just in time for the 2027 holidays.

item.title: Sure, ‘Melania’ Did Great for a Documentary, but That Doesn’t Mean It Over-Performed
item.description: With a $7 million opening weekend, it's the highest opening for a non-music doc in over a decade, but the $40 million price tag — plus another $35 million for marketing — for Amazon tells a different story.

item.title: Hollywood Still Needs That Sundance Energy
item.description: At the final days of the 2026 Sundance Film Festival in Park City, the festival's enduring power never felt more clear.
